column1: # PadChest anatomical location hierarchy, transcribed by hand from Bustos et al., "PadChest:
# A large chest x-ray image dataset with multi-label annotated reports", arXiv:1901.07441v2,
# Appendix A.1.3 (pp. 30-32). One row per line of the printed tree, in printed order.
# The tree is a DAG printed as a tree: some locations appear under two parents (e.g. under
# `lobar` and under `lung field`), so names repeat. studies / studies_with_children are
# the paper's "study counts" / "study counts with child labels"; cui is blank where the
# paper gives none. Not in the paper but in the label CSV: `lumbar vertebrae`.
